description: This file provides NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library) utility functions for distributed GPU operations in PyTorch, including version info, availability checks, and collective communication methods like all_reduce, reduce, broadcast, all_gather, and reduce_scatter.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if NCCL is available with the provided tensors, verifying device and contiguity constraints.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the NCCL version as a tuple, including suffix if present.

methods.name: init_rank
methods.description: Initializes NCCL rank with number of ranks, unique ID, and rank index.
